question: 近3个月销售额
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2013-10-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2014-01-01'

question: 各月销售额趋势
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.InvoiceDate), SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i GROUP BY 1

question: 各大区销售额
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.Country IN ('USA','Canada') THEN '北美' WHEN c.Country IN ('Argentina','Brazil','Chile') THEN '南美' WHEN c.Country IN ('Australia','India') THEN '亚太' ELSE '欧洲' END, SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY 1

question: 销售额Top5的国家
expected_sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 北美销售额
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country IN ('USA','Canada')

question: 北美和南美哪个销售额高
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.Country IN ('USA','Canada') THEN '北美' WHEN c.Country IN ('Argentina','Brazil','Chile') THEN '南美' ELSE '其他' END, SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country IN ('USA','Canada','Argentina','Brazil','Chile') GROUP BY 1
note: 多取值 -> 升级为维度对比

question: 客单价是多少
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.InvoiceId) FROM invoices i

question: 2009年各季度销售额
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) || '-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', i.InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3), SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2009-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2010-01-01' GROUP BY 1
note: 绝对时间 + 季度维度

question: 按曲风统计销量
expected_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) FROM invoice_items il JOIN tracks t ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN genres g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId GROUP BY 1
